title: How 450 Humpbacks Became 25,000
closing: Recovery is possible when protection lasts longer than the damage.
question: Can this recovery last?

segments.say: The humpback population reached 25,000, transforming a near-collapse into one of conservation's clearest comebacks.
Experts count 10 recovered humpback populations, while others still need protection to finish the comeback.
Commercial whaling killed 2.9 million whales last century; stopping it gave depleted populations room to rebuild.
